text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading out on my day off—
I bumped right into Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. To see my grandfather... my grandparents.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: They're temporarily back in the country and staying at their home here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Believe's grandfather had graciously agreed to meet me on short notice during her trial contract period. ...I'd like to pay my respects properly once more.
choice_data_list: Would it be okay if I came along to say hello?
Would it be alright if I came along to say hello?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Oh... well, yes.
I'll ask.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—It seems it's fine.
...This way, then.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you for coming all this way.
Thank you so much for looking after our granddaughter.
choice_data_list: Not at all, the pleasure is all mine...

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Please, come on in. My husband is here too.
...And Believe, it's been so long! How are you doing? Eating properly?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Meals are provided at the dorms, so I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Believe speak in a somewhat softer tone than usual brings a smile to my face.
...Though part of me wishes we could achieve that same comfortable distance.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
I hear you've been crafting all sorts of things at the academy, Believe.
...Hehe, you've really grown into a fine young lady.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a "job." Nothing special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From the cooking hearth at the training camp to the academy's flower beds, she diligently handles every repair and finishes them to perfection.
choice_data_list: She truly takes after a master craftsman!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I got a little carried away praising her—and glancing at Believe, I saw an awkward look on her face. ...Was I being annoying?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The flower bed... wasn't very good work.
...I wasn't satisfied with it.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...
—Hehe, a flower bed, you say? What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
My husband has taken quite a liking to making single-flower vases and planters lately too.
Using leftover scraps from work, wasn't it, dear?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
...Putting leftover materials to good use.
There are plenty of uses for 'em.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Turn 'em into knickknacks, and someone'll want 'em.
That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—I want to see.
Grandpa, can you show me?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Dear, you finished a few pieces recently, didn't you?
Why not show them? And to the Trainer as well, if they'd like.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: This is a single-flower vase. The frame on this one's simple, but with a bit of ingenuity in the mold, you can make somethin' like this.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
This one's a planter.
Castle motif. The pot's a stone wall, and the back's a house ornament.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every piece he showed us looked like a gorgeous piece of home decor.
Vases adorned with delicate patterns, rustic castle-shaped planters...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Incredible......

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Um, Grandpa.
What did you use as the mold for this vase's base?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Pieced together some scrap wood for the shape.
A milk carton would do the trick just as well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: What about this one? This pattern... is it mortar art?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Aye. Even in buildings, folks often ask for patterns on walls.
It's an application of plastering technique.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They're truly beautiful... I wonder if Believe, who works so quietly and diligently, will make pieces like this one day... No, not one day—
choice_data_list: Couldn't you make one too? A vase, I mean.
Couldn't you make one too? A vase, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—!
No... I'd like to try, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Care to try your hand at it, Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Come here. I'll walk you through the whole process.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(*clack, clack, clack, clack... tap, tap...*
*—shhk, shhk...*)

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Assemble the frame carefully so the mortar doesn't wobble.
Keep a clear image of the finished piece in your head.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Craft a cube with absolute precision, without a fraction off.
Giving it value as a unique piece comes much later.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Right. —Ah, this joint doesn't fit well.
I need to shave down this board a bit more...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Grandpa, can I start mixing the mortar soon?
I remember the ratios.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to my careless comment about Believe making one too, things had turned into quite a full-blown workshop...

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Those two, honestly...
—Oh, I'm so sorry, Trainer. You must be bored, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, is it really okay for me to just relax like this?
Isn't there anything I can do...?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: —Can't sit still?
choice_data_list: Huh, ah... Y-Yeah, sorry about that...

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Don't fret. It's only natural. But you see—
Neither of them will accept any help once they get like that.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Once they step into their "craft,"
it becomes a world of just them and their work. ...No one can intrude.
choice_data_list: Does that go for... you as well, ma'am?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. The most I can do
is prepare an environment where they can focus like that...

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Still, you know... If you wait quietly in silence,
they'll show you some truly exquisite "work."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Listening to her words, I watch the two of them lose themselves in their "work."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honest, steady hands working in absolute silence.
Earnest, focused eyes facing the beautiful craft, refining it to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: As for the thickness... should we shave it down?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thickness, huh... Yeah, thinner looks cleaner...
Factoring in durability... around that much... that feeling... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though rugged and unembellished, their profiles
somehow radiate vibrant life.
choice_data_list: ...They're two peas in a pod, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they certainly are...
Those two just grow more alike with every passing year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to become someone who can quietly,
gently support that craft... this very time. Someday, I hope—
choice_data_list: (I can be right by her side to witness her finest "work.")

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
......Your Trainer is quite an eccentric one.
Reminds me of my old lady, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think so...?
